# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Rowena P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Dawn P14](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0014), [v3 ch.Dawn P19](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril is characterized by his endearing good looks. Among his striking features are his magnificent dark eyes.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 ch.Dawn P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044)_

## Personality

Cyril Lisle is characterized as a somber and mysterious figure. He lacks a sense of humor, leading others to perceive him as potentially dull to be around.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

## History

Cyril Lisle left university two years prior to travel overseas with his mother due to her declining health. After sheltering [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) from a rainstorm, he pursued a romantic relationship with her by sending flowers and poetry, taking her to a college reception, and arranging a visit from his family. He eventually proposed to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in a pavilion by the shore, but she realized she did not love him, rejected his proposal, and ended their relationship.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 ch.Charming P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Charming P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 ch.Rowena P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), +11 more_

## Relationships

### [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cyril-lisle--dorothy.md)

[Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) is Cyril's sister. During a walk, Cyril informs [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that his family plans to visit, and [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) later attends the chaotic gathering at Tabby's Place where she connects warmly with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), +3 more_

- Sibling of — sister  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Weddings P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cyril-lisle--nell-harcourt.md)

Cyril was infatuated with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and expected to marry her, escorting her to a [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) reception and arranging a visit with his family. However, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) favors Hugh Carrow's gifts over Cyril's at [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation). Although Cyril proposes to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in a shore pavilion as she packs up Tabby's Place, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) realizes at the last moment that she does not love him, turning him down and breaking off their relationship.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Rowena P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Rowena P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004), [v3 ch.Rowena P6](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0006), +16 more_

- Romantically involved with — infatuated with each other and expected to marry  <sub>[v3 ch.Rowena P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004), [v3 ch.Confidences P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), +1 more</sub>
